en: Read it?

{0E}*            Night is dangerous            *
*    When the sun goes down, go on home    *
*                                          *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*            Night is dangerous            *
*    When the sun goes down, go on home    *
*         Or you'll die, you know          *{0F}{w}
note: Sign gag: page 1 leaves the third line blank, page 2 fills it with the punchline. Box lines centred with ASCII spaces inside '*...*', 44 chars wide.

en: There's a signpost.{w}You could probably read it from the front.{w}
Adventurer

"Damn it, what IS that freak!?
If we fight it head-on, we'll get wiped out...{w}Maybe it'll go to sleep if we wait till night?"{w}

"That freak's gone to sleep...{w}Now we can probably get past it, but moving around at night is dangerous.
...Wait, so we STILL can't go on!? Ugh, man..."{w}
note: tohoho -> 'Ugh, man...'. The joke: they waited for night so the monster would sleep, but night travel is too risky.

en:
"That stone statue over there is a real trickster.
It's fine while it's asleep, but once it wakes up..."{w}
note: kuwasemono = something not as harmless as it looks.

en:
"I-I feel sick...
Why is there a spinning floor in a place like this..."{w}
note: Rows 167-192: two unnamed adventurers. A (ore, rough) and B (atashi, gets dizzy and throws up). Speakers alternate as noted; no pronouns used for either, since neither has a glossary gender.

en:
"Didn't I tell you?
Don't rush in. You've gotta be more careful."{w}
(...Not that any of that is sinking in, I bet.){w}
note: A's thought. Japanese has no subject ('kiitya inee'); rendered impersonally to avoid a he/she for B.

en: "My head's spinning... Urp..."{w}

"Night's already fallen.
It's dangerous, so let's stop moving and camp out here."{w}
"...I'm sorry."{w}
"Huh!?"{w}
"I'm always causing you trouble, aren't I?"{w}
"Wh-what's gotten into you all of a sudden!?{w}You, apologizing to me? That's not normal!{w}Did you hit your head or something?"{w}
"This is how everyone ends up leaving me.{w}In the end I'll be traveling all alone!{w}And then I'll die in a ditch somewhere! Uuu..."{w}

"You've got me, so...
you won't be all alone..."{w}

"I-I mean, well... y'know!"{w}{p}"You don't listen, you're pushy, you're an idiot,
you've got nothing going for you at all.{w}But strong-willed types... I don't hate 'em."{w}
note: A. 'ki no tsuyoi yatsu, kirai ja... nai shi' = a fumbled confession; kept the hesitation before the admission.

en: "...Ugh... Uuuuugh..."{w}
note: B is about to vomit; A mistakes it for crying (row 181). Kept the sound ambiguous between a sob and a retch.

en: "Hey, hey~ No need to cry, right?"{w}
"How do I put it? It's not like I'm against it either..."{w}
note: A. 'manzara demo...' (not entirely unwilling) -- interrupted, kept trailing.

en: "Nope. Gonna puke."{w}
"Huh?"{w}

note: Shared line (dupes 7).

en: "Phew, that feels so much better.{w}...Ew, what's with that robe!? It's filthy!"{w}
"Y-y-y-YOU DID THIIIS!!"{w}
note: A: 'o-oooo, omae ga--!!' = 'you (did this)!' Rendered as the accusation it implies.

en: "You stink, so stay away from me. Honestly."{w}
"Why, you little...{w}Hey... wait, not that way!!"{w}
"Whoa-a-a-a-a~?"{w}
note: B: 'aaare--?' = the classic cry of someone being swept/spun away; B wanders onto the spinning floor again.

en: "Where am I supposed to take all this rage..."{w}
As you stood before the door, it began to open with an earth-shaking rumble.{w}
note: Generic door line (dupes 72).

en:
There's a firmly sealed door.
You can't see anything that looks like a keyhole.{w}
note: Generic door line (dupes 70).

en: Mage

"Something's off.
There's a patch around here I can't fill in on the map.{w}Have we overlooked something?"{w}
Thief

"Sounds to me like
we oughta suspect a secret door."{w}
"A hidden door, hm..."{w}

"My gut says it's gotta be real close by.
Let's go look for it!"{w}
There's an altar.{w}It's the perfect place to throw yourself down and grovel.{w}
note: dogeza = kneeling bow to the floor (abject apology/begging). Joke sign-off kept.

en: There's a signpost that reads "Kembeck's Shop".{w}

{0E}*          To all you adventurers          *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*       First, check your equipment        *
* Have you equipped your swords and armor? *
*  Get potions and such at Kembeck's Shop  *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*   Mages w/o a Magic Seal have it rough   *
*     If there's a mage in your party,     *
*      get one at Kembeck's Shop too       *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*     Next, let's set up your compass      *
*      Just carrying it isn't enough       *
*      Open Camp and use the compass       *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}* Make an Angel's Window to find your way  *
*      You'll get lost way less often      *
*  Get home without string or breadcrumbs  *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}*   Head west down the road to find Abi    *
*   Near the entrance: a healing spring    *
*       In Roscadil: Toner's Armory!       *{0F}{w}{p}{0E}
*      Good luck out there, everyone       *{0F}{w}
note: Tutorial sign. Angel's Window and compass as in wmap slices 05/09; 'Toner's Armory' = Tonaa bugu-ten (new shop name, Toner from glossary). 'Abi-san ga' = Abi is there. Kept source layout: leading blank line, page 1 one line, last page on line 2.

en: A huge flood of water came surging in.{w}The water, pumped up from underground, swept you away before you could do a thing.{w}
Water came crashing down from overhead.{w}The water pumped up from underground became a raging torrent, and blasted you away with overwhelming force!{w}

Water came flowing out of the room.{w}You tried to hold your ground but slipped,
and the water carried you away.{w}
There's a crumbling stone tablet.{w}
Examine it?

As you brushed away the thick heaps of dust, barely legible letters came into view.{w}{p}'Sudden** light was lost from the l*nd, and those born of dark*** be*an to run ram*ant.'{w}{p}'Even with the ** power of the wind, we could n** hold back the encroachment of ****.'{w}{p}'Among the fiends that welled up from the earth*** was the form ** the Progenitor.{w}Though a fi**, ** held ** in high regard.'{w}{p}'*e made the **priest and the daughter of the *icked **mage Zanu** our proxies for the land, and negotiated with the Pro*****.'{w}{p}'Through the work of the * priest and the daughter, ** welcomed the Progenitor's ** true ** as the new ** light.'{w}{p}'From among the spirits dwelling in *****rtowa, a suitable guard*** was led **.'{w}{p}'By some means, the daughter guided the guardian's ***stal and crowned the Sun Spirit.{w}The sunlight was succes*fully reg*ined.'{w}{p}'*light shall pour down upon the land ** dispel the darkness and drive back evil.'{w}{p}'However, not all came to a goo* end ***.'{w}{p}'Those wh* cared for the guardian thought ill of the coronation.{w}In response, the spirits ** the wind broke away, and built an otherworldly realm in the gap betw*en heaven ** earth.'{w}{p}'And the Progenitor did not return, but descended upon the eastern lands. **s intent is beyond fathoming.'{w}{p}'We earnestly ** that this ** decision of ours will lead to a ***ght future.'{w}{p}The inscription ends there.{w}
note: Damaged inscription: '*' marks missing letters, placed at roughly the same points as the source gaps. taiso -> 'the Progenitor' (new term; a demonic being the land's people negotiated with, later 'new light'). Zanu** = partial name of a (wicked?) mage whose daughter was the proxy. '*****rtowa' = most likely Nertowa (wmap slice_02). taiyousei = Sun Spirit (wmap). 'tsukasa' read as priest (sai-shi?) -- could be another office. Gaps used to avoid a pronoun for the Progenitor.

en:
Graffiti-like letters were carved into the crusty old stone desk.{w}{p}'Patrol outside on a stormy day!? You've gotta be kidding me!
O great Agin, won't you come down here...'{w}
note: Agin (Agin-sama) = new name, apparently a deity (asked to 'come down'); 'O great' used instead of 'Lord' to avoid assuming gender. 'urotsuke' read as an order the writer was given (guard on patrol).

en: Sluice Room{w}
note: op031 map/room label (cf. wmap 'Rotating Floor'). housui-beya = water-discharge room.

en: The hole in the wall is pumping up the water at your feet.{w}

There's a strange mechanism in the wall,
and a hole just above the floor.{w}
The hole in the wall began pumping up the water at your feet.{w}
There's a switch. Press it?
The switch turned off.{w}
The switch turned on.{w}
There's a slimy signpost.{w}
You tried to read it, but the water had risen too high to make it out.{w}

note: Konnu -> 'Connu' (new name; the dungeon files are named FM_CONNU, so probably the place). Workplace safety-chant parody. 'chuui saretashi' (archaic notice style) -> plain notice wording.

en: On the stone desk lies a weathered parchment document.{w}
Read it?

note: shimatsu-roku -> 'Incident Report' (written account of a blunder). Koreapper (Koreappaa) and Ildam (Irudamu) = new names. shinsaku = 'the new one' (a new work -- book or similar, left vague as in source). '--' lines are the interrogator.

en: You found something in a corner of the passage.{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Reservoir Key.{w}
note: New key item: Reservoir Key (chosuichi no kagi).

en: There's nothing in particular here.{w}
On the stone desk lies a weathered parchment document.{w}{p}'The same menu up to three times, I can forgive. But...'{w}{p}It went on and on with gripes about the wife's cooking.{w}
note: 'the wife's' keeps the writer's gender open.

en: On the stone desk lies a weathered parchment document.{w}{p}'Today's weather: sunny.{w}Seems like a good time to sow the regie seeds...'{w}{p}It was crammed with records of the weather and the crops.{w}
note: Rejie -> 'regie' (new term: a crop; lowercase as a plant name).

en: Tarrit is surrounded by monsters.{w}
note: Tarrit (Taaritto) = new name, Valkyrie girl met in slice_002 rows 118-153. Calls the player 'aruji' -> 'Master'.

en: "GYAAAH! He-e-elp me-e-e-e!{w}Ooh! Passing by over there -- it's Master!{w}
note: No closing quote: the line continues in row 231 (as in the source).
{0E}..{0F} repeats row 230 exactly ({w} of row 230 shown as \n here, matching the source).

en: "GYAAH! This is no time for that!{w}Master, as you can see, I'm in a real pickle!{w}Help me out heeere! GEEEEEH!!"{w}
"..........Okay! Playing dead!"{w}
"I'm leaving the rest to you, Master!{w}I'm gonna play dead till it all blows over!"{w}
More and more monsters keep appearing.{w}
note: Shared line (dupes 7).

en: "...I'm dead and all, but go get 'em~..."{w}
"..........I'm dead and all, but is it over yet?{w}
note: No closing quote: continues in row 238.

en:
{0E}"..........I'm dead and all, but is it over yet?{0F}
Aah, I'm saved! Thank you, Master!"{w}
note: {0E}..{0F} repeats row 237 exactly.

en: "Boy, traveling alone sure is dangerous~{w}It's way better to be with somebody!{w}
note: No closing quote: continues in slice_004 row 240, whose {0E}..{0F} part must repeat this text exactly (with \n in place of the {w}).
